user_request: Database every 10 tasks; Codebase every 5 tasks; retain completed tasks and continue Codex.
scope: Codex only; both isolated existing R1 streams
counting: Absolute one-based task position across each stream; final partial batch flushes at stream end.
extraction: Every task, native per-thread extraction; reuse already completed extraction.
consolidation: Only at batch positions, one native global job over accumulated extracted sources.
old_results: Keep unchanged; no replay. Mixed scheduling regime explicitly recorded.
source_isolation: Separate homes per method/environment; no future task in maintenance.

timeout_recovery_authorization.source: User approved 1800 seconds for Codex batch consolidation and recovery of the interrupted native writer.
timeout_recovery_authorization.lease_reclamation: Only quiesced actor lease/cooldown; native retry_remaining unchanged.

activation: New or resumed controllers load this policy. Existing frozen controllers retain the actual wait recorded by their runtime until a safe restart.
